outcomes.label: Ad shown
outcomes.subject: object
outcomes.description: One paid ad impression served to someone on an ads network (Google Ads, and any future Meta or LinkedIn ads channel). The money for it is already charged by the network; a share of impressions turn into a website visit.

outcomes.label: Audience built
